thread:
maya_pm: Vendor sent updated timelines: H200 GA slipped two weeks, MI300 requires fw v2.1.0 for marketplace images. Need quick cross-org check to avoid accidental unlock.

ernest_vendor: Confirmed. FW v2.1.0 includes a power-throttle mitigation for B200 variants. We're still running partner lab validation — should have builds by EOD tomorrow.

carmen_eng: If fab patch changes perf, we need to update perf guidance and CI gates. Can vendor attach a minimal repro or logs?

ernest_vendor: Uploading logs to partner bucket now. Short summary: 4hr soak showed ~7% tail latency on one B200 SKU; fw v2.1.0 reduces it to ~2%.

anya_market: Marketplace asks: signed image SHA, declared kernel/fw in metadata, and regional availability before we unlock SKUs. Also legal needs 5 business days for co-announcement prep.

drew_si: SI needs the firmware blob + SHA, an acceptance checklist, and a 48h soak across two regions. We'll run soak and report pass/fail.

maya_pm: Proposed immediate actions: 1) vendor uploads fw + SKU impact list (ernest, EOD tomorrow), 2) eng PR for image naming + CI gating (carmen, +48h), 3) SI soak template (drew, +48h), 4) market embargo draft (anya, sync).

cal-bot: maya_pm scheduled "MI300/B200 marketplace handoff" on 2025-03-26 10:00 PT with maya_pm, ernest_vendor, carmen_eng, anya_market, drew_si. Invite sent.

carmen_eng: I'll open a PR for naming: `redwood/market/{vendor}/{model}/fw-{ver}/sha-{short}` and add gating rules: temp <=84C, perf_drop <=10%.

drew_si: I'll draft soak recipe and a rollback stub for SKUs. If soak fails, we'll request image hold and escrow the SHA.

maya_pm: Thanks all — post blockers here before the sync. If vendor signals a regression we'll reschedule announcement accordingly. :thumbsup:
